title: Spherical modules and the Auslander--Gorenstein condition for Auslander--Yoneda algebras
summary: For a finite dimensional algebra $A$ of finite global dimension we study the Auslander--Yoneda algebra defined as the Yoneda algebra of the direct sum of all indecomposable $A$-modules. We show that the Auslander--Yoneda algebra is an Auslander--Gorenstein algebra if and only if every indecomposable left and right $A$-module is spherical in the sense of Auslander and Bridger. This motivates the study of spherical algebras defined by the condition that every indecomposable module is spherical.
